\textit{CFOF} can be efficiently computed and it exhibits state of the arts performances in detecting outliers in large high dimensional datasets, even in the presence of strong concentration phenomena.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: (1) the definition of a novel notion of outlierness that does not concentrate in high dimensional spaces, (2) the definition of an efficient algorithm for computing the new outlierness score, and (3) the definition of the parallel implementation of such algorithm.
the design of a novel notion of outlierness that is adaptive to different levels of local density and that does not concentrate in very high dimensional spaces.

the design of a novel score, \hbox {\hbox {C}FOF}, that is robust with respect to the intrinsic dimensionality of the data, and that is able to detect outliers in very large datasets with a scalable and efficient algorithm.
